integrity: One new mathematical claim; the classical one-defect radius formula is not represented as new; finite-section computations are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only weights with no zeros and positive convergent moduli. It does not cover arbitrary bounded weights; tail essential-spectrum and infinite-block arguments are analytic rather than computational.
title: A spectral-gap characterization of smooth points of the numerical-radius weighted-shift norm
